notes.text: Source report: the title replaces “tubulaires” by “coniques”. The page defines a “voisinage conique” (also “cône sur Y”) using a space T containing Y, a closed part dot T, and an action of the multiplicative interval monoid I=[0,1]. The source axioms a), b), c), the starred pushout explanation, the canonical-map identifications and the final interior formula are transcribed. This description by itself is not a proof check. No outside source was used.

Main-reader targeted deduction, communicated by root and retained as a check: a) and b), together with the continuous unital I-action, imply a strong deformation retraction of T onto Y. Let r(t)=0t and H(s,t)=(1-s)t. Then H(0,t)=t, H(1,t)=r(t) is in Y by b), and H(s,y)=y by a). In particular r(y)=y. This explains the right marginal “sur une rétraction” without adding words to it.

Main-reader targeted deduction: the weaker condition 0.dot T subset Y, together with a) and the cocartesian square c), implies b). In the pushout every point has a representative y in Y or lambda b with b in dot T. For y, 0y=y by a); for lambda b, the action law gives 0(lambda b)=(0 lambda)b=0b in Y. This verifies the intended marginal implication. The written NB nonetheless ends at “entraînent”: the parenthesized token is kept once at the diagram position as (2)|(b), not supplied as the verb’s missing object.

Main-reader targeted deduction: the pushout identifies the whole copy {0}×dot T with its image in Y and makes no other identifications between Y and (0,1]×dot T. Thus the latter points and Y form the disjoint representative description. The source star-note bijection from I_{]0,1]}×dot T to T minus Y is consistent with that quotient description. It does not establish that this bijection is a homeomorphism, and the transcription does not add such a statement.

Main-reader targeted deduction for the final equation: using the representative description, the union of lambda T for 0≤lambda<1 is Y union ((0,1)×dot T), hence T minus dot T. One inclusion follows because multiplying a representative with positive parameter by lambda<1 yields parameter below 1. Conversely, a parameter mu<1 is mu times a parameter-1 representative, and Y is fixed. This verifies the equation defining the interior and explains how the action determines the boundary as its complement.

Main-reader targeted quotient-topology check: a subset of the pushout is open exactly when its inverse images in Y and I×dot T are open. Root audit of the enlarged rotated note resolves the visible continuation as inverses/inverse dans I×dot T et dans Y le sont; the final predicate is present in the ink. The previous draft claim that it was missing is withdrawn. This independently recovered wording agrees with the quotient-topology check; the check itself did not supply the reading. The crossed label above bij. is recorded separately as doubtful homéo.

Possible author slip / unresolved letter in (3): the argument of f looks like a closed a rather than the crossed x used on the right of 0.x. Both witnesses print f(x)=0.x. The diplomatic text retains f(a|x)=0.x with a preferred. Mathematical consistency would favor using x on both sides, but the check does not settle the letter against the ink.

Notation and geometry are kept literal. The T forms have single roofs; bold serif I was checked locally, including all five occurrences in the middle action paragraph P28. The main square has four objects, four shafts, six heads and one hook, counted twice. Later situation connectors have outer hooks but no secure central heads; their intended inclusion/map interpretations do not supply those heads. The colon after “isomorphe”, the unmatched extra closing quotation after tube, the source Le before the cancelled application, and the incomplete NB ending are preserved; the star note has a visible final le sont.

Reading record: the assigned original was viewed once, both supplied native halves once, and each saved first-pass crop P00–P26 once. P27 was authorized specifically for the still-open original-orientation attachment of the number/NB ending. Only the still-open rétraction ending was then consulted in saved P11; no new crop of a decided place was made. P28 is the first crop of the previously uncropped action paragraph, to check local I weight. There were no OCR, recognition libraries, outside research, compilation, other-page images, or other-page reports. Root independently reviewed all 29 crops.

The faint narrow lower-left 11 is retained separately from the large author folio 1). Its hand is not attributed with certainty from line weight alone. The canonical-map formula ends in source f without parentheses; no hypothetical punctuation beyond the physically clipped right edge is supplied. Pale substrate/stain marks were not transcribed as text.

Independent second-reading audit: root personally inspected every nonidentical box, plus targeted enlarged portions of the homotopy/star notes and wider original-image crops for B24 and B29. B24 clipped the dot above T; B29 covered Soit rather than the circled 1. The fixed first and second readings are preserved, and final changes are recorded separately.
